text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,960.6, up 0.63% on the day, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.1% and Bank Nifty gained 0.67%. Advances outnumbered declines 404 to 87, giving a breadth score of 60.3 (healthy) and keeping 65.4% of stocks above their 20‑day moving average. The rally is fairly broad, with 17 stocks hitting 52‑week highs and only two making new lows.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹14,974.68 crore, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹10,444.54 crore, extending a five‑day selling streak for DII and a seven‑day buying streak for FII. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.34 for Nifty, indicating more put (bearish) interest, and the max‑pain level sits at 24,350, within the expected range of 24,259‑24,814. The call wall at 25,000 and put wall at 23,000 may act as resistance and support respectively.

Watch the Nifty pivot points: support at 23,784.3, pivot at 23,872.5 and resistance at 24,048.8. A break below the 23,784 level could test the 23,000 put wall, while a move above 24,048 may push the index toward the 25,000 call wall. Also keep an eye on the India VIX, down 3.37% to 15.19, as lower volatility often supports continued buying.
